# Linkbreakers CLI

The `linkbreakers` binary is the official CLI for the Linkbreakers API.

Install:
- Homebrew: `brew install linkbreakers-com/tap/linkbreakers`
- npm: `npm install -g linkbreakers-cli` (the npm package `linkbreakers` is the TypeScript SDK, not the CLI)
- Script: `curl -fsSL https://cli.linkbreakers.com/install.sh | bash`
- Binaries: https://github.com/linkbreakers-com/linkbreakers-cli/releases

Preferred usage:
- `linkbreakers links list`
- `linkbreakers links get <id>`
- `linkbreakers links create --destination https://example.com`
- `linkbreakers directories list`
- `linkbreakers custom-domains list`

Authentication:
- `LINKBREAKERS_TOKEN`
- `linkbreakers auth set-token --token <token>`

Fallback:
- `linkbreakers raw METHOD PATH`

Update:
- Homebrew: `brew upgrade linkbreakers`
- npm: `npm install -g linkbreakers-cli@latest`
- Script or binary installs: `linkbreakers self-update`

Primary human-readable docs:
- `README.md`
- `docs/commands/linkbreakers.md`
- Agent skills: https://github.com/linkbreakers-com/agent-skills
